alert.rule_name: MSBuild Executed a Project File From a Non-Development Path
alert.description: MSBuild.exe executed a project file located outside any recognised source-code or build-agent path. MSBuild is a signed Microsoft binary that will compile and run arbitrary C# supplied inline in a project file, so it is used to execute code on hosts where unsigned binaries would be blocked or noticed.
alert.detection_logic: Sysmon EventID=1 (ProcessCreate) WHERE Image ENDSWITH '\MSBuild.exe' AND CommandLine MATCHES '\.(xml|csproj|proj|targets)' AND CommandLine NOT MATCHES ANY (source_root_paths, build_agent_paths, '\\Program Files')
